channel.title: Nuntii Batavi
channel.description: The Netherlands, between The Hague and Brussels.

item.title: Ten JEF nations, including the Netherlands, to sign naval partnership pact
item.description: The agreement commits the ten navies to interchangeable equipment, parts, ammunition and personnel, with command from Northwood in London. A Russian senator called the plan a provocation.

item.title: Plan the Dutch defence budget as if the American cheque never arrives
item.description: Congress authorises the money, the president decides whether it moves, and this year showed which half wins. The cabinet should stop writing American funds and troops into our planning as if they were certain.
